retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist, high-contrast monochrome portrait layout featuring a central subject emerging from deep black negative space with thin, geometric typography at the top.
triggerTerms: chiaroscuro portrait with top-aligned thin sans-serif
subject emerging from black negative space

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white portrait where the subject's face is the primary light source against an expansive black background. The composition is vertically oriented with a large amount of negative space at the top and bottom, featuring a single line of delicate, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text centered at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject face as a bright focal point against absolute black
Thin, wide-tracked typography balancing the heavy visual weight of the portrait
Vertical alignment of text and facial features
Soft, grainy texture throughout the mid-tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is centered horizontally and positioned in the upper-middle third of the frame, scaled to occupy approximately 25% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit face serves as the primary anchor, while the thin text at the top provides a secondary, stabilizing anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, moves upward to the text, and then follows the subject's hair or clothing downward into the darkness.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 70% of the frame is solid black or deep shadow.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy white (highlights on face and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: No pure whites; use slightly off-white or cream for highlights

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text elements to maintain minimalism.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s geometric aesthetic and thin stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and circular forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome portrait of a subject centered in the frame. The lighting should be dramatic chiaroscuro, with the face brightly lit and the rest of the body fading into a solid black background. Apply a subtle film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text in the top center using a thin, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif font in an off-white color. Ensure the text is small and does not crowd the top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the text thin and widely spaced?
Is the text centered at the top?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Deep, rich blacks without digital noise

postGenerationChecks: Check for true black levels in the background
Verify text legibility at small scale
Ensure grain is uniform and not distracting
Confirm horizontal centering of all elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Top-Aligned Thin Sans-Serif + Expansive Black Negative Space
